title: SurgRAW: Multi-Agent Workflow with Chain of Thought Reasoning for Robotic Surgical Video Analysis

defines.name: SurgCoTBench
defines.definition: A reasoning-focused benchmark for robotic-assisted surgery with frame-level annotations and QA pairs across multiple surgical tasks.

defines.name: SurgRAW
defines.definition: A clinically aligned chain-of-thought driven multi-agent workflow for zero-shot multi-task reasoning in robotic surgery videos.

problem: Existing surgical AI and VLM methods are fragmented, task-specific, and often lack interpretability and robust reasoning under the domain gap of robotic surgery videos.
